name: Qdrant MCP Server
summary: Official Qdrant MCP server that acts as a semantic memory layer: `qdrant-store` saves information with metadata and `qdrant-find` retrieves it by similarity.
description: Configured with environment variables (Qdrant URL or local path, API key, default collection, FastEmbed embedding model). Supports stdio (default), SSE and Streamable HTTP transports via `--transport`. Run with `uvx mcp-server-qdrant` or Docker.
